guides.title: Key not detected, or push-button start won't start
guides.summary: The car says the key isn't found, the remote doesn't lock or unlock, or pressing start does nothing.
symptoms: car not starting, key not found
remote key doesn't lock the car

steps.text: Press the brake (automatic) or the clutch (manual) firmly while you press start.
Hold the key right against the start button (or in the marked slot) and press start.
steps.detail: This works even with a flat key battery.

steps.text: Replace the key's coin battery (often a CR2032; check the one inside).
steps.detail: 'Key not detected' is usually the first sign of a weak key battery.

steps.text: Keep phones, chargers and other keys away from the key; strong radio signals nearby can interfere.
Try the spare key. If it works, the first key needs service.

escalate.text: The key or the car's key reader needs a check.

guides.title: Car won't start, or the battery is weak
guides.summary: Nothing happens, it clicks or cranks slowly, or it cranks but doesn't start.
symptoms: car won't start in the morning

steps.text: What happens when you try to start?

options.label: Nothing, or the dashboard is dark
It cranks normally but doesn't start

steps.text: Switch off the headlights, AC and accessories and try again. Look for a loose or white-crusted battery clamp, without touching it with bare hands.

Jump-start from another car with jumper cables in the order your owner's manual shows (red to the plus terminals; black to the other car's minus and then to bare metal on your engine), or call roadside assistance.
steps.detail: Don't jump-start a battery that is cracked, leaking or frozen.

steps.text: If it started, drive for at least 30 minutes to recharge, and get the battery tested soon. Batteries wear out faster in heat.
Check there's enough fuel (the gauge is unreliable when nearly empty), and that no key or immobiliser light is flashing; try the spare key.

escalate.text: Call your roadside assistance number or a mechanic.
tell_service: What happens when you press start
When the battery was last replaced

guides.title: Tyre pressure warning
guides.summary: The tyre pressure light (a tyre with an exclamation mark) is on or blinking.
symptoms: tyre mein hawa kam ka warning

steps.text: Stop when it's safe and look at the tyres. If a tyre is flat or damaged, don't drive on it: change the wheel or call roadside assistance.
Fill all tyres to the pressure on the sticker in the driver's door frame or fuel flap, with the tyres cold.
If your car asks for it, reset the tyre pressure system after filling (a button or a menu such as Tyre pressure > Reset), then drive for a few minutes.
On a cold morning the light can come on and go off after driving; check the pressures anyway.

escalate.text: If the light comes back the same day, a tyre may have a slow puncture: get it checked at a tyre shop.
tell_service: Which tyre the car shows, if any
Whether it blinks first and then stays on (a sensor fault)

guides.title: Electric car not charging
guides.summary: Charging doesn't start or stops, at home or at a public charger.
symptoms: home charger not charging the car

steps.text: Put the car in Park and push the connector in until it clicks; check the car's charging light or screen.
At home: check the socket's switch and the circuit breaker (MCB), and plug straight into the wall without an extension cord.
steps.detail: Extension cords can overheat with a car charger.

steps.text: Check the charge limit and any charging schedule in the car or its app.
steps.detail: Charging won't start if the battery is above the limit or a timer is set.

steps.text: At a public charger: start the session in the operator's app or with its card, and try another charging point.
steps.detail: Many failures are on the charger's side.

steps.text: Charging is slower above 80% and when the battery is very hot or cold. That's normal and protects the battery.
steps.detail: If the connector is stuck, use the release in the car's menu or app, or the manual release your owner's manual describes. Never pull it with force.

escalate.text: The car's charging system or the charger needs a check.
tell_service: Home or public charger, and which one
Any message on the car or charger
